name: CM Process Solutions LLC
old_description: Dump buggy tumblers have been specifically designed to revolutionize mixing processes in food, beverage and pharmaceutical manufacturing, our dump buggy tumbler offers high quality consistent and safe mixing of products such as pasta salads, RTE (ready to eat) meals and protein products like chicken, ribs, and pork loins.
about:
CM Process Solutions LLC is based in Winchester, Kentucky. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures dump buggy tumblers for mixing, coating, marinating, and infusing products such as pasta salads, ready-to-eat meals, and proteins including chicken, ribs, and pork loins. Its product line also includes stainless steel hygiene equipment, lifting and dumping systems, and industrial washing machinery. The tumblers use a bi-directional rotation method without paddles or blades and offer vacuum-assist marination. A newly commissioned demonstration center allows customers to test equipment before purchase.

CM Process Solutions serves hygiene-conscious industries across North America, with a focus on food processing, beverage, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Its customer base includes meat and poultry processors, as reflected by associate memberships in the American Association of Meat Processors and the U.S. Poultry & Egg Association. The company works with industry leaders to develop custom equipment as well as standard solutions.

The company emphasizes innovation in sanitary equipment design, supported by a dedicated team of engineers, sales, and service associates. It differentiates itself through custom-made equipment, a demonstration center for process validation, and partnerships with major food-processing trade organizations.
